text: A Song of Ascents. Behold, bless{H1288} ye Jehovah,{H3068} all ye servants{H5650} of Jehovah,{H3068} That by night{H3915} stand{H5975} in the house{H1004} of Jehovah.{H3068}
Lift up{H5375} your hands{H3027} to the sanctuary,{H6944} And bless{H1288} ye Jehovah.{H3068}
Jehovah{H3068} bless{H1288} thee out of Zion;{H6726} Even he that made{H6213} heaven{H8064} and earth.{H776}
